datasets.name: Paleobiology Database: occs/diversity API (data1.2)
variables_present: per-interval genus counts with boundary-crosser fields xft, xbl, xfl, xbt (from which origination/extinction rates can be computed), dsb, dib, noc (occurrence count per bin)
datasets.scope: Global marine and terrestrial fossil occurrences, queryable per clade and bin
datasets.evidence: API 200: two sample records returned with the field names above (e.g. bin 'Chibanian' eag 0.774, lag 0.129, noc 114).

units with top/bottom ages (t_age, b_age), thickness and column ids

summary: PBDB's diversity endpoint and Macrostrat's open CC-BY API supply rates, collection counts and rock-column/unit data, so rock-record and origination/extinction series can be built per interval. No ready dataset classes intervals or regions as uplift versus subsidence (sea-level curves were not found as a repository dataset), and speciation of 'varieties' is not recorded.
next_step: Choose shallow-marine genera and a sea-level or accommodation proxy (e.g. a published curve) by region; build per-bin rates from PBDB with sampling standardization; pre-register uplift/subsidence bins.
obstacles_confirmed: Uplift and subsidence are spatially heterogeneous
Transgression can raise marine origination, unlike Darwin's island case
